text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Do you have a moment right now?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I do think I have some guts in me.
Though... that only shines through at the crucial moment.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"In order to keep running in the future...
Why don't you give that a little more thought?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae appeared concerned about race fatigue.
Perhaps it would be best to reconsider her race schedule...
